dj.line:
A pool that deals itself in as its own token — the house writing the deck, then cashing it out with a card that doesn't exist. The zero address on the other side is the tell: there's nobody across the table but the mirror.

So tell me, friend — when you buy in, who exactly do you think is holding the other end of your hand?
